evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml:26-28 `[verifier]` timeout_sec = 13200.0, environment_mode = "separate"; tests/Dockerfile:43 `COPY . /tests` (verifier ships its own tests); environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), no solution/ or tests/. [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" (line 37-38); per SKILL.md delivery profile and the workbook row text, no allowlist is required. Pinning: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical (diff) to the template: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim, npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, chromium installed via the pinned playwright-mcp's bundled playwright; apt unpinned (NOTE per check-dockerfiles.py). Judge files: all five judge.toml [judge] headers + mcp blocks are textually identical to the template (diff of each file up to [scoring] empty); each has judge = "claude-code" with no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight key in [judge] (grep for `model =`/REWARDKIT_MODEL/reasoning/temperature in tests/*.toml found nothing; `weight` keys appear only on [[criterion]] blocks). test.sh is byte-identical to template and refuses to grade (zero reward) when REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset (test.sh:63-66). tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and .dockerignore identical to template. Counterexample search: a broken app cannot exploit this row (no judge model override, no answer key in agent image, grading in separate image); a conforming app cannot be failed by this wiring statically. Risk=true only because the credentialed end-to-end judge launch (OpenRouter key -> claude-code -> glm-5.3-flashx) is not measured: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'; its entries are scripted golden observations in a built verifier image (hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair), not a configured judge run. Notes (not defects): base images use version tags, not digests (template-controlled, accepted by check-dockerfiles.py definition); Internal Quality Checks row 10 mentions an 'allowlist', which is superseded by the public-network delivery profile and current workbook row text.
